# Kotlin Testing Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Backend > Kotlin

## Overview

Writes comprehensive tests for Kotlin applications using JUnit 5, MockK, Kotest, and coroutine testing utilities

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [kotlin-testing-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
kotlin-testing-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@kotlin-testing-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Write tests with JUnit 5 and Kotlin extensions
- Mock dependencies with MockK coEvery and every
- Implement property-based tests with Kotest
- Test coroutines with runTest and TestDispatcher

## Technology Standards Applied

- **MockK**: Kotlin-first mocking library patterns
- **Kotest**: Property-based and spec-style testing
- **Coroutine Testing**: Testing coroutines with controlled dispatchers
